title: What essentials should I pack, and how are daily needs, medical requirements, and luggage managed at Ashaeiynn?

segments.text: Identity Verification & Check-In ​Mandatory Official ID: All attending members must bring a valid government-issued photo ID (such as an Aadhaar card, PAN card, Voter ID, Driver's License, or Passport) to ensure a smooth and seamless check-in process upon arrival. Luggage Storage & Daily Needs ​Luggage Room Provided: A designated luggage room is provided for storing all your bags, luggage, and personal items throughout your stay to keep the living spaces neat and uncluttered. ​Assistance On-Site: All your basic day-to-day needs will be met during the Mahotsav. If you require something that is not immediately available, simply ask the volunteers—they will be happy to assist and arrange it for you. ​Medical Conditions & Personal Medication ​Bring Your Own Medicines: Guests with pre-existing medical conditions must bring an adequate supply of their own prescribed medications and medical provisions. ​No Nearby Pharmacies: Pharmacies are not available in the immediate vicinity of Ashaeiynn. ​On-Site Doctor: While we have a doctor available at Ashaeiynn for general assistance, it is essential and highly beneficial that you carry your own necessary medications and personal care supplies for the duration of your stay. ​Packing Checklist & Essential Items ​Weather & Rain Gear: Since it is the rainy season, please make sure to bring umbrellas and raincoats. ​Weather-Appropriate Clothing: The weather in Ashaeiynn can be hot and humid, causing extra sweating. Please pack enough light clothing as well as extra pairs of innerwear to stay comfortable. ​Personal Hygiene & Grooming: ​Bring your own deodorants and perfumes to help you stay fresh throughout the day in the humidity. ​Pack your personal toiletries (soap, shampoo, sanitary products, etc.), hair dryer, washing powder/detergent, and enough towels. ​Attire Guidelines: ​Traditional Wear: Traditional attire is highly appreciated for pujas and special spiritual events. ​Attire for Women: Women are requested to bring scarves or dupattas. ​Personal Bedding Preference: While shared accommodations are provided, you are welcome to bring your own bedsheets and pillows if you prefer not to use common shared bedding. ​Sacred Area Rules: Leather & Animal Products ​Strict Havan Area Restrictions: Items made of leather or animal skin (such as leather belts, bags, purses, or shoes) are strictly prohibited in and around the havan area. ​Please ensure all leather items are removed and safely stored inside your luggage before entering the havan space. ​Important Notice for Women Guests Regarding Menstrual Planning ​Sacred Space Restrictions: In accordance with Ashaeiynn's tradition, women currently on their periods are not permitted to enter the main halls or the havan area, nor participate in the rituals inside. Access is restricted to the reception area. ​Plan Your Visit Accordingly: We strongly recommend scheduling your travel after your periods are over so you can fully participate in the Mahotsav. If you must travel during your period, please be aware in advance of these space restrictions. ​Off-Site Accommodation Suggestion: Because the reception area will be extremely crowded during the event, resting there for extended periods may become uncomfortable. We highly advise booking a nearby hotel outside the Ashaeiynn if you are attending during your cycle so you can rest comfortably.
